program.name: Quick Feet 35
program.subject: Athlete
program.blurb: Quick feet and change of direction with no gear: lateral jumps or hops, a circuit, balance.
program.about: Agility without equipment. One day opens with lateral jumps and bounds, then a leg circuit of lunges, side squats and adductor work; the other opens with quick hops, then an upper-body circuit. Balance closes both. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder moves.
program.split: Lateral jumps & leg circuit / hops & upper circuit, 35 minutes
